items.title: Medspillere i topklub kom til at røbe stjerneangribers skade

items.titleEn: Top club teammates came forward to cover up the damage of the star attackers.
items.summaryEn: The absence of the Chelsea top scorer against Tottenham was revealed in the Fantasy Premier League by fellow players and the club's own staff.

items.title: I København satte Zelenskyj fingeren på Europas problem
items.summary: Det går ikke, at 30 ledere fra Europa taler med Vladimir Putin, så Europa bør udpege én forhandler, lød opfordringen fra Volodymyr Zelenskyj under besøg i København.
items.titleEn: In Copenhagen, Zelensky put his finger on Europe's problem
items.summaryEn: It is not possible for 30 European leaders to talk to Vladimir Putin so that Europe should appoint one negotiator, Volodymyr Zelenskyj called for during a visit to Copenhagen.

items.title: Trumps seneste opslag følger et gammelt mønster
items.summary: Donald Trump accepterede i første omgang resultatet af midtvejsvalget, men nu er han tilbage med sine uunderbyggede påstande om valgsvindel.
items.titleEn: Trump's latest post follows an old pattern.
items.summaryEn: Donald Trump initially accepted the results of the midterm elections, but now he's back with his unsubstantiated claims of election fraud.

items.title: Han vandt DM, men fik frataget sin titel. Nu indstiller 27-årig karrieren
items.summary: Johan Price-Pejtersen har mistet lysten til professionel cykling og siger farvel til sporten.
items.titleEn: He won the DM but was stripped of his title. Now the 27-year-old's career is over.
items.summaryEn: Johan Price-Pejtersen has lost his passion for professional cycling and is saying goodbye to the sport.

items.title: Ny øl er inspireret af verdens længste slæderejse
items.summary: Et samarbejde mellem Eventyrernes Klub og et dansk bryggeri har ført til en øl, der hylder et noget ukendt og overset stykke Danmarkshistorie.
items.titleEn: New beer is inspired by the world's longest distillation journey
items.summaryEn: A collaboration between the Club of Adventures and a Danish brewery has led to a beer that celebrates a somewhat unknown and overlooked piece of Danish history.

items.title: Signe Wenneberg hængte privat familie ud. Nu viser dokumenter, at sagen er mere speget
items.summary: Mandag blev Signe Wenneberg politianmeldt for tre forhold, og tirsdag er yderligere to tilføjet. Det sker efter en kovending, hvor hun på ny har delt en families adresse på sine sociale medier.
items.titleEn: Signe Wenneberg was hanging private family. Now documents show that the case is more blurred.
items.summaryEn: On Monday, Signe Wenneberg was reported to the police for three counts, and on Tuesday, two more were added. It's after a co-op, where she shared a family's address on her social media accounts.

items.title: Grishams retssalsdrama gør stærkt comeback
items.summary: John Grishams mesterlige retssalsthriller om medicinalbranchen og dens ofre får nyt liv i ganske glimrende, men lovlig lang serieversion.
items.titleEn: Grisham's courtroom drama is making a big comeback.
items.summaryEn: John Grisham's masterful courtroom thrillers about the pharmaceutical industry and its victims are being revived in a rather brilliant, but legally long, serial version.

items.titleEn: Greenland's minister withdraws shortly after impeachment
items.summaryEn: Nivi Olsen, who has been the Naalakkersuisoq for education, culture, sport and church, is withdrawing from the government.

items.title: Sæsonens første snebyger kan være på vej
items.summary: Der er ikke noget, der tyder på, at man skal finde kælken eller skiene frem trods snemelding, oplyser DMI.
items.titleEn: The first snowfall of the season may be coming.
items.summaryEn: There is no indication that the heel or skis should be found despite snowfall, DMI reports.

items.title: Mette Frederiksen sagde »nej« til at være Europas stemme. Og det er der tre grunde til, siger Bent Winther
items.summary: Volodymyr Zelenskyj opfordrede tirsdag til, at Europa finder én person, der taler på vores vegne, når det kommer til forhandlinger med Rusland. Mette Frederiksen afviste, at det skulle være hende, og det er der gode…
items.titleEn: Mette Frederiksen said "no" to be the voice of Europe. And there are three reasons for that, says Bent Winther
items.summaryEn: Volodymyr Zelenskyj called on Tuesday for Europe to find one person to speak on our behalf when it comes to negotiations with Russia. Mette Frederiksen refused to let her do it, and that's good...

items.title: Minister trækker sig fra Grønlands regering efter krav fra eget parti
items.summary: Nivi Olsen, som har været minister for uddannelse, kultur, idræt og kirke, trækker sig fra regeringen.
items.titleEn: Minister withdraws from Greenland's government at the request of his own party
items.summaryEn: Nivi Olsen, who has served as Minister of Education, Culture, Sports and the Church, is resigning from the government.

items.title: Berlingske mener: Sisse Marie Welling og Line Barfod er trumpisme på dansk
items.summary: Tankegangen hos flertallet i Borgerrepræsentationen er totalitær, som da vi for årtier siden fik lov at lege turister i østblokken, mens diktaturerne forbød deres egne borgere at tage på ferie til Danmark.
items.titleEn: Berlingske thinks: Sisse Marie Welling and Line Barfoot are trumpism in Danish
items.summaryEn: The majority's thinking in the Citizens' Representation is totalitarian, as when decades ago we were allowed to play tourists in the Eastern Bloc, while the dictatorships prohibited their own citizens from going on holiday to Denmark.

items.title: Kan det betale sig at arbejde, når din bolig tjener mere end dig?
items.summary: Meritokratiet som begreb hører efterhånden mere til i en teoribog end i virkelighedens verden. I stedet bevæger vi os mod en rentierøkonomi, hvor man i praksis kan leve af at eje.
items.titleEn: Can it be worth working when your home earns more than you?
items.summaryEn: Meritocracy as a concept is becoming more of a book of theories than of the real world. Instead, we're moving towards an interest rate economy where you can actually live off owning.

items.title: Gerningsmanden bag skyderiet i Krakow søgte på Anders Breivik før angrebet
items.summary: Polens justitsminister bekræfter, at den nu afdøde gerningsmand havde søgt på den norske terrorist forud for skyderiet i Krakow.
items.titleEn: The man behind the Krakow shooting searched for Anders Breivik before the attack.
items.summaryEn: The Polish Minister of Justice confirms that the now deceased perpetrator had searched the Norwegian terrorist prior to the Krakow shooting.

items.title: Politi stopper togdrift på Fyn for at efterforske påkørsel

items.titleEn: Police stop train operations in Fyn to investigate traffic
items.summaryEn: Trains on Fyn will be stopped on Tuesday night after a train hit something near Langeskov, police said.
